title: The Inheritance of Ashcombe
author: Silas Nakamura
blurb: Gideon Halloran, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
